findings.title: ML / Quantitative: $30,000 capital, zero positions
findings.observation: Pod 'ML / Quantitative' has a $30,000 budget and currently holds $30,000 with zero open positions.
findings.why_wrong: CRO at HIGH may justify caution, but idle capital earns zero return and represents a failure to execute on the pod's mandate.

findings.title: CRO=HIGH for 17 cycles (68 days) — board must vote
findings.observation: The CRO has been at HIGH for 17 consecutive pipeline cycles (~68 days). During this time, all new buy orders have been blocked. The board last met 999 days ago.
findings.why_wrong: An extended buy block is a major business decision. It should require ongoing board ratification — not just persist automatically. It penalizes research agents for low approved-picks even when they're working correctly.
findings.suggestion: Board should formally vote: (1) Is HIGH still warranted? (2) If yes, what specific condition triggers a downgrade? (3) If no, step down to ELEVATED with 25% cash floor instead of 40%.

findings.title: Board has not met in 999 days despite 3 IRM flags

findings.why_wrong: IRM flags that sit unaddressed for >7 days represent a governance failure. The board exists to act on them.
findings.suggestion: Trigger a board meeting: `python3 board_meeting.py`. IRM and CRO should be primary agenda items.

findings.title: ML model running but no live picks are being tracked for real-world validation

findings.title: ML pod has $30,000 but NO trained model exists
findings.observation: data/model_meta.json reports no trained model (model.pkl present=False). The ML / Quantitative pod has $30,000 allocated but there is no model to generate or validate signals. Any AUC shown elsewhere is not coming from a real model.
findings.why_wrong: A pod allocated capital against a model that was never trained is operating on nothing. This also means every downstream 'model AUC' display is meaningless.
findings.suggestion: Run `python3 predictive_model/ml_model.py` (or overnight_ml_runner.py) to train and persist data/model.pkl + model_meta.json. Until then, the ML pod should hold cash, not deploy on phantom signals.

findings.title: 6 open positions have no review recommendation

findings.title: 3 expected agent(s) silent on firm channel >7 days
findings.observation: These agents have not posted to the firm channel in 7+ days: Chief of Staff, IRM Director, Operations Director. Either they're not running or their output isn't reaching the channel.
findings.why_wrong: Silent agents are invisible agents. If an agent stops communicating, nobody knows whether it's healthy or broken.
findings.suggestion: Check crontab and most recent logs for each silent agent.

findings.title: ML / Quantitative: $30,000 capital, zero positions
findings.observation: Pod 'ML / Quantitative' has a $30,000 budget and currently holds $30,000 with zero open positions.
findings.why_wrong: idle capital earns zero return and represents a failure to execute on the pod's mandate.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish the cause, then act: (1) run `python3 ml_pipeline.py` — if it produces picks, this was a pipeline stall, not a policy choice; (2) if it produces nothing and CRO isn't blocking, lower the pod's conviction threshold or widen its watchlist; (3) if the pod is intentionally flat, write the reason and a concrete re-deploy trigger into pod_allocations.json so this stops re-firing.
